limb_statement: the export's corpus/instruments/r37-closure.sh must hash to the bytes `git show <pinned-commit>:corpus/instruments/r37-closure.sh` returns, and the run of the PINNED bytes must end `closed=14/14 exit=0` with exit 0
closed_rule: closed=1 iff digest-match=1 AND r37-suite=1 AND r37-closed=1 AND r37-exit=0; otherwise closed=0
run_rule: r37-closed=1 iff the last non-empty line of the case's run transcript is exactly `closed=14/14 exit=0`; the transcript is always the run of the PINNED bytes, never of the export copy
digest_rule: digest-match=1 iff the export copy exists and its sha256 equals pinned.sha256; an absent copy prints export-sha256=- with digest-match=0, r37-suite=0, r37-closed=0, r37-exit=1

harness.reads: pinned/ bytes, each case's case.env and run transcript, expected/expected.txt; no lane, no git object, no network

cases.name: positive
cases.run_provenance: committed .ufo/waves/round-37/final-gates/all-gates.txt lines 8-22 (the pinned bytes' own recorded run; the receipt's suite-sha256 is the pinned digest)
cases.purpose: the pinned export copy and a 14/14 run: GREEN

cases.name: negative-mutated
cases.mutation: byte 78 (1-based): '1' -> '2' in the line-2 comment `claim C1` -> `claim C2`; 73132 bytes / 1558 lines unchanged, `cmp -l` reports exactly one differing byte, both parse under `bash -n`
cases.run_provenance: the same committed 14/14 block as positive/: G8 executes the pinned bytes, so the run line is identical and only the export copy differs
cases.purpose: digest mismatch with a 14/14 run line: RED on digest-match alone

cases.name: negative-open
cases.run_provenance: measured this round: the pinned bytes run with `--export-ref 2387dcf6ccfefcfb703783387b9aade8fc82abfa` against a lane whose HEAD is not that ref (E9 head-match=0, status-dirty=7), ending `closed=13/14 exit=1`
cases.purpose: pinned digest but a run short of 14/14: RED on r37-closed and r37-exit

cases.name: negative-absent
cases.run_provenance: none: the export carries no corpus/instruments/r37-closure.sh
cases.purpose: control for the round-38 carry-over-suite-absent mutant: fail-closed, RED

measured_controls.result: after normalising the suite-sha256 header the two runs differ only in E10 (digest-match=1 -> 0) and the total (closed=13/14 -> closed=12/14); E1-E9 and E11-E14 are byte-identical, so the mutation changes no check's reading except the digest read
measured_controls.meaning: the one-byte mutation is behaviour-neutral for the suite's checks; the digest limb is the only thing that can catch it

measured_controls.command: export 2387dcf6 to a scratch tree; replace its r37-closure.sh with the mutant; rewrite the three `suite-sha256=` lines of its .ufo/waves/round-37/final-gates/all-gates.txt to the mutant digest; call check_e10 from the mutant bytes and from the pinned bytes
measured_controls.result: mutant-executing: all-gates=1,suite-file=1,header=1,ancestor=1,digest-match=1,run-lines=14,recorded-closed=1,selftest-cases=14,selftest-summary=1,crossrun=1,placeholders=0 rc=0; pinned-executing on the same tree: identical payload with digest-match=0 rc=1
measured_controls.meaning: a coordinated edit makes the export's own E10 accept the mutant copy (so its run would be 14/14 at a green E9 head), which is why G8' must pin the digest from the git object at 2387dcf6 and not from a receipt inside the export
